items.title: the incr-48 merge (M121's reach record + M110 S4's const cache) costs every cold `vilan check` +0.66..+1.06% instructions: all nine `ci` example rows over their 0.5% ceilings at next @8ab08bb2 (math x1.0106, watch x1.0104, router x1.0087, rpc x1.0078, canvas x1.0077, reactive-ui x1.0075, browser x1.0072, fullstack x1.0070, todo x1.0066)
items.body: CI run 37899366213 on 8ab08bb2; the two merges before it (4b4a63c6, ecf3aef5) were green on the same ceilings. incr-48's own kolt measurement (17.51-17.55 G base vs 17.47-17.54 G) had a +-0.2% noise band that could not see a 0.7% uniform tax. Suspects: the `ImplReachLog` recording around the pre-entry resolve (every impl member/trait question is recorded, on the CLI too, where no hot seed can ever exist) and the const cache's content-key hashing per site in a single-process check. Fix: the reach record is free when no hot seed exists; the key hashing as cheap as the measured split allows; a counter pin (a check with no hot seed records nothing); the ci rows back under their ceilings without a bump. incr-48b.
